top_signals.title: Gold Declines as Traders Weigh Prospects for Interest-Rate Hike
top_signals.summary: Gold declined ahead of a potentially divisive decision on US interest rates later this week, while a fragile pause in Middle East hostilities soothed inflation fears.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Commission approves €149 million Swedish State aid for agricultural, fishing and aquaculture companies facing increased fuel and fertiliser prices
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 28 Jul 2026 The European Commission has approved a €149 million (SEK 1.6 billion) State aid scheme for agricultural, fishing and aquaculture companies facing increased fuel and fertiliser prices due to the Middle East crisis.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China’s reported chip breakthrough comes with some big caveats
top_signals.summary: China is reportedly producing a key chip tool in a market dominated by ASML. But analysts questioned China's ability to compete with the Dutch giant.

top_signals.title: Commission seeks feedback on proposed amendments to regional State aid guidelines
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 28 Jul 2026 The European Commission has launched a public consultation inviting all interested parties to comment on its proposal to amend the Guidelines on regional State aid to keep them up-to-date.
